summary: Loading earlier messages no longer stalls the frame that delivers them: the transcript adopts an older page into the assistant runtime one batch per frame, starting with the next frame

replay.detail: Rendering only; no replay or rebuild.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client or public API changes; older rows appear one frame later and then in the same batches as before.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores adoption of the first batch in the prepending commit.
